d:
This is not machine translator version. Redrew part is made by manually by my hand through Ibis paint on phone and translation (text) is typed on laptop using Photopea. I only started manual translating and redrawing yesterday, so it will not be immaculate. You may notice some imperfection like bad translation, or ass redrawing or some grammar errors.
Also I'm very thankful and sorry about the AI version. I didn't think it would cause such uproar. Frankly, at first, I was very surprised by the machine translation. The words were neatly arranged and very fast, especially there was barely any image distortion. However, after many times look through again, it was pretty ass. Consequently, I decide to translate the whole hentai by hand.
The translation and fixing process took more than half a day, maybe around a day since I don't even know how to start.
This is the second time I upload.
Source I get to translate: 661661
